comment: Markers whose Amoebius allocation is the ENGINE's, not the game's: an engine API that copies on every call (Unity's does not). perf_hunt.py amoebius reports them as 'engine shim (known)' instead of a regression, and lists them in the report so the number is never mistaken for the game's. Remove an entry when the engine stops copying; the task names who owns that.

CrystalChargeArcs.LateUpdate.reason: Mesh.SetVertices(List)/SetUVs(List<Vector4>)/SetTriangles(List) copy their lists into fresh arrays on every call in Amoebius (Port/src/CosmicShore.Engine/Rendering/Mesh.cs:249,289, Mesh.Extras.cs:78,139); the renderer detects a changed mesh by array identity (Port/src/CosmicShore.Render/SceneRenderer.cs:2676, :1428), so the copies are how it is told. The game's own code reuses its writer lists and cached arrays (Assets/_Scripts/Controller/Environment/Crystals/CrystalChargeArcs.cs:187-196). Unity's SetVertices(List) allocates nothing.
CrystalChargeArcs.LateUpdate.task: see Docs/TEAM_TASKS.md, area Performance, 'Amoebius: Mesh.Set*(List) copy per call'

CrystalDepthPrisms.LateUpdate.reason: MaterialPropertyBlock.SetVectorArray(Vector4[]) clones the array on every call in Amoebius (Port/src/CosmicShore.Engine/Rendering/MaterialPropertyBlock.cs:68); the game passes one cached Vector4[] (Assets/_Scripts/Controller/Environment/Crystals/CrystalDepthPrisms.cs:77,196). Unity's SetVectorArray copies into native memory without a managed allocation.
CrystalDepthPrisms.LateUpdate.task: same task as CrystalChargeArcs.LateUpdate (the engine's copy-per-call stand-ins)

StoatPathfinder.Dots.reason: Mesh.SetVertices(Vector3[], start, length) and SetUVs(channel, Vector2[], start, length) copy the range into a fresh array on every call in Amoebius (Port/src/CosmicShore.Engine/Rendering/Mesh.Extras.cs:107-117, ArraySegment.ToArray); the game passes its cached arrays (Assets/_Scripts/Controller/Vessel/R_VesselActions/StoatPathfinderWorldDots.cs End). Unity's ranged SetVertices / SetUVs allocate nothing.
StoatPathfinder.Dots.task: same task as CrystalChargeArcs.LateUpdate (the engine's copy-per-call stand-ins)
